about_the_game:
Seven Sinners is a western roguelike with turn-based QTE combat about bandits from the Wild West.

Lead the gang of the Seven Sinners through the prairies and forests of the Wild West, saloons, canyons and hospitals. You will fight not only bounty hunters, but also the sheriff's dogs, the feds, hunger and disease. Uncover stagecoach routes and bankers' secrets, and rob a train using the innovative turn-based QTE combat system.

  • Turn-based QTE combat will challenge not only your tactical sense, but also the speed of your trigger fingers.

  • Classic CRPG and roguelike features, including permanent character death, procedural global and battle maps provide replayability.

  • Global Map. Plot your way through the Wild West wisely, taking into account the state of the Sinners and your supplies.

  • Hire. Bony took one of the Seven Sinners? Visit the saloon, maybe there will be a desperate head there.

  • Set up camp to heal your wounds, hunt and rest.

  • Cities. Behave calmly and maybe the sheriff will not open fire first.

  • A good combination of a western and card board games.

Can you escape the Sheriff's mutts, grab the jackpot and ride off into the carefree sunset? Saddle up your Sinners horses and shoot straight!

short_description: Seven Sinners is a western roguelike with turn-based QTE combat, following a band of outlaws from the Wild West. Recruit new sinners into your gang, rob stagecoaches and banks, roam the prairies, and evade the sheriff and his hounds. Will you get rich or will you disappear into the prairies?
